Adverse events may be captured either as free text or via a pre-specified list of terms. 2. Adverse Event Description and Coding a. AETERM captures the verbatim term collected for the event. It is the topic variable for the AE dataset. AETERM is a required variable and must have a value. b. AEMODIFY is a permissible variable and should be included if the sponsor's procedure permits modification of a verbatim term for coding. The modified term is listed in AEMODIFY. The variable should be populated as per the sponsor's procedures. c. AEDECOD is the preferred term derived by the sponsor from the coding dictionary. It is a required variable and must have a value.
